slides.h1:
Why Most Astrology Apps
Skip the Hard Part
slides.sub: The computing behind a real reading.

slides.body: A Sun-sign horoscope is one lookup. Twelve answers cover millions of people.
A real reading uses exact birth time and place, divisional charts (vargas, sub-charts), the running dasha (planetary period), current transits (gochar) and Ashtakavarga (a point-strength system).
Each layer has its own rules, and the layers can disagree. Resolving that disagreement is the real work, and it is slow and error-prone by hand.
Calculating charts and applying rules consistently, every time. Judging what matters for a person stays with a trained astrologer.
